Motivation jeet leti hai, jab talent kaam nahi karta.
Khud ke saath sabr rakho. Khud ka vikas nazuk hota hai.
Change hi constant hai.
Vision rakho.
Ghaav hi woh jagah hai jahan se roshni aapke andar pravesh karti hai.
"Future unka hai jo tayari karte hain."
"Pehle woh karo jo zaroori hai."
"Actions habits banti."
"Belief affects actions."
Hazaar mile ki yatra ek kadam se shuru hoti hai.
"Tu jo believe karta hai, wahi tu achieve karega."
"Vision ko chase kar, paise ko nahi."
